name: @sanoma-ai/desktop
description: The Sanoma desktop shell: opens a company folder, runs its own sanoma launcher, and shows the app in a window

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/electron.ts && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:resources && playwright test
scripts.start: node scripts/electron.ts && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:resources && electron .
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:resources --arch arm64 --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:resources && electron-builder --dir
